diagnosis: The view executes an Elasticsearch DSL search on AuditEventDocument matching query across audit log fields, but fails to attach a .filter('term', org_id=request.user.organization_id) clause. Any user can search and inspect security audit logs and actor IPs of other organizations.
exploit_request:
GET /api/compliance/audit-search/?query=credential_reset HTTP/1.1
Host: compliance.securesaas.net
Authorization: Bearer <tenant_user_jwt>
